svg.text: Stage 3: Spinal CPG Locomotion, Basal Ganglia GPi Disinhibition & Dexterous Slip Reflex
End-to-End Closed-Loop Execution: Alternating Bipedal Gait, Striatal Action Gating, and 25ms S1->M1 Cortico-Motoneuronal Grip Reflex
A. Two-Layer Spinal CPG Bipedal Gait (Sensory Phase-Resetting via Ankle Ib Unloading & Hip Ia Stretch)
Cyan: Left Hip Angle (rad) | Pink: Right Hip Angle (rad) — Anti-phase locomotion emerging from half-center I_NaP pacemakers + Hill muscles
B. Basal Ganglia GPi Disinhibition & Dexterous 10-DoF Hand Tactile Slip Reflex (Sudden 2.4x Object Load Increase at t=200ms)
Gray: GPi Tonic Brake | Amber: Thalamic Gate | Red: Fingertip Slip Velocity Spike | Green: M1 Burstprop/BTSP Grip Force Recruitment (N)
